candidates.explanation: The access-token strategy verifies the bearer token with 'auth.refreshSecret', but access tokens are signed with 'auth.secret' (auth.service.ts around line 619). The signature check always fails, so every protected request gets 401. Login and refresh still work because the refresh strategy and token issuance use the correct secrets.

fix.description: Use the access-token secret 'auth.secret' as secretOrKey instead of 'auth.refreshSecret'.
